Cc: procurement@cobaltlabs.com
Date: Tue, 9 Sep 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: emergency sandbox top-up & expedited procurement

Hi Soojin,

Hope youre well. Were in the middle of a tight eval sprint and hit a procurement delay with legal — our sandbox promo credits expired yesterday and a bunch of running tests are now failing. We have an internal demo to the board next week and losing access right now jeopardizes that presentation (and the PoC momentum).

Quick facts:
- Account: Cobalt Labs (DEAL-0847)
- Expired promo: 5,000 token sandbox grant (expired 2025-09-08)
- Impact: integration tests failing, blocked demos for 3 teams

Ask: Is there any way Redwood can temporarily top up our sandbox by 7 days (equivalent to ~5k tokens) and flag the account for expedited procurement review? Well sign any necessary paperwork this week and route DocuSign to your legal contact.

I know this is an exception request; were asking because the timing is tight and the board demo is a high-impact milestone. Happy to hop on a short call to confirm details.

Thanks,
Liam Carter
Head of ML — Cobalt Labs
liam@cobaltlabs.com

--

Hi Liam,

Thanks for the note and context — sorry to hear about the timing. We can usually support a short safety-net top-up in situations like this while procurement wraps up.

Proposed one-time playbook:
- Immediate: temporary 7-day sandbox top-up (equivalent to 5,000 tokens) to restore access so your demo/tests run uninterrupted.
- Condition: sign a short credit amendment + MSA acknowledgement in DocuSign by EOD Friday (well send the link).
- Ops: we create a ticket with Engineering to prioritize cache warming so your running workloads dont hit cold-start penalties.

If that sounds acceptable Ill get internal approvals and a credit adjustment template over to you. If youre open to a 3-way call (product + procurement + me) I can schedule 15 minutes tomorrow.

Next steps from our side: Im escalating to Prioym for approval and looping in Karhtik to coordinate procurement/sales handoff.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
